input.summary:
Designed and wrote parts/room-4.mjs (west ground corridor): a north-wall console (dark oak planks on fence legs, lit candle, standing lantern, flower pot), a barrel and pot at the west end, a red carpet runner on the z52 walking lane, and hanging lanterns on chains every 4 cells at x28/32/36/40/42. On a scratch build (shell plus this room, no runParts lock) light is min 9 with 0 dark cells, and the lane and doorway cells stay clear.
The shared build.nbt does NOT contain the part: runParts refuses all 37 of its writes because the shell's fill(..., "air") over the room interior counts as placed air, so every room part is locked out. make.sh still writes a whole build.nbt.
left: The runParts lock blocks every room part: parts/shell.mjs line 27 fills the main-block interior with "air" and runParts treats that air as placed, so room-4's 37 writes are REFUSED (0 placed). Fix belongs in the shell (leave room interiors unwritten, or carve only where needed) or in runParts; I did not bypass the lock.

The walk verdict is UNREACHABLE (0 of 34 cells) and fit says 'hallway to nowhere' only because the entrance hall (room-1), the front steps and the garden-door stoop are still stubs. Recheck once those parts land.
Checklist not ticked: this part is not in the merged build.nbt yet. The scratch check (/tmp/part11-test/test.mjs) bypasses the lock and is not a deliverable.

waste.what: Worked out the floor-grid column indices (x27 = index 0, the 17-char rows, the lantern and console cell positions) by hand, and re-counted each string to check it
waste.cost: about 6 edits and 3 retries of the row strings
waste.tool: mcd plan should print the origin and index-to-x mapping, or accept named cells (e.g. at(33,51)) so layers() rows come from coordinates

waste.what: Found by trial that the shell's air fill locks every room, only after a full make.sh run; there was no pre-check for which cells runParts will refuse
waste.cost: 1 make.sh run, about 37 refused writes reported only in make output
waste.tool: a runParts dry-run or a 'locked for this part' column in mcd plan that lists the cells an earlier part wrote (air included) before a worker starts

waste.what: Wrote a scratch harness to run the shell plus my room on a plain Grid so the room check could read the light and layout
waste.tool: mcd room --after-parts <part-list> (or a --no-lock flag) that builds the earlier parts and then the room being checked, without the write lock

waste.what: Checked the light by reading the LIGHT LEVELS rows by eye and reasoning about lantern reach
waste.tool: mcd room already prints the lamp spots; a mode that prints the exact new lamp spot to add would have saved the second iteration

companions.role: stair joiner / partition carpenter (the shell's worker)
companions.task: Fix the shell's interior air fill at parts/shell.mjs line 27 so room cells stay writable for furnishers, or agree which cells the shell truly owns. This is the blocker for every room part.
Check the corridor light once the room is in the merged build; the scratch check already shows min 9, but the console lantern and the x42 hanging lantern are the only sources that matter.
Make the entrance hall reachable from the outside so the corridor's walk verdict and hallway-to-nowhere check can be read in the real build.
